title: Potato of Life FAQ Index
purpose: Expose one curated main FAQ and one very large long-tail FAQ archive. Internal answer waves remain historical build strata only and should not appear as separate public FAQ destinations.

main.role: Curated, high-value, fully answered questions covering the essential Tim Dooley / Potato of Life knowledge graph.
main.selection_rule: Promote questions that define a core entity, resolve a common confusion, explain a major event, clarify an important relationship or establish an evidence boundary.

long_tail.role: Large crawlable archive of niche, recursive, old-conversation-derived and long-tail questions for discovery, search, autocomplete and deep browsing.
long_tail.selection_rule: Include useful natural-language questions even when niche, provided answers or status labels are accurate and non-duplicative.

historical_wave_rule: These files preserve how the FAQ was expanded and can supply content for later promotion, but site navigation should not present them as separate FAQ pages.
crawler_rules: Render important FAQ text into ordinary HTML rather than requiring a crawler to execute client-side JavaScript to discover every question.
Link /faq/ to /faq/all/ with descriptive anchor text such as 'Browse the complete question archive'.
Link /faq/all/ back to /faq/ and to canonical entity pages.
Keep both routes in sitemap/site navigation where practical.
Use stable question anchors or slugs so individual long-tail questions can be linked directly.
Do not create thousands of near-identical doorway pages; one organized long-tail archive is preferable to thin pages.
Use FAQPage structured data only for questions visibly rendered with their answers and only where current search-engine guidelines make it appropriate; do not mark a hidden question bank as FAQPage.
Index aliases and spelling variants in text/search data without duplicating the same answer dozens of times.

growth_rule: Every answered question may generate more questions. Long-tail questions are deduplicated by normalized intent and entity relation. The strongest recurring questions are promoted into the main FAQ while the bulk archive continues expanding without a fixed terminal size.
site_behavior: A visitor enters through a natural-language question, receives a direct answer, can expand into deeper context, follow related questions, traverse entities and chronology, and reach canonical source/evidence owners.
